campaign_intakes_closed_at_check.name: campaign_intakes_closed_at_check
campaign_intakes_closed_at_check.value: ("campaign_intakes"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "campaign_intakes"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("campaign_intakes"."status" <> 'CLOSED' AND "campaign_intakes"."closed_at" IS NULL)

campaign_outbox_delivered_at_check.name: campaign_outbox_delivered_at_check
campaign_outbox_delivered_at_check.value: ("campaign_outbox"."status" = 'DELIVERED' AND "campaign_outbox"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("campaign_outbox"."status" <> 'DELIVERED' AND "campaign_outbox"."delivered_at" IS NULL)

campaign_outbox_claim_lease_check.name: campaign_outbox_claim_lease_check
campaign_outbox_claim_lease_check.value: ("campaign_outbox"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "campaign_outbox"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_outbox"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("campaign_outbox"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "campaign_outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "campaign_outbox"."locked_until" IS NULL)

campaign_players_active_match_check.name: campaign_players_active_match_check
campaign_players_active_match_check.value: ("campaign_players"."status" = 'IN_RING' AND "campaign_players"."attempts_used_today" = 1 AND "campaign_players"."active_match_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("campaign_players"."status" <> 'IN_RING' AND "campaign_players"."active_match_id" IS NULL)

campaign_ring_players_metrics_check.name: campaign_ring_players_metrics_check
campaign_ring_players_metrics_check.value: ("campaign_ring_players"."final_health" IS NULL OR "campaign_ring_players"."final_health" >= 0) AND ("campaign_ring_players"."account_xp" IS NULL OR "campaign_ring_players"."account_xp" >= 0) AND ("campaign_ring_players"."battles_played" IS NULL OR "campaign_ring_players"."battles_played" >= 0) AND ("campaign_ring_players"."lifetime_kills" IS NULL OR "campaign_ring_players"."lifetime_kills" >= 0) AND ("campaign_ring_players"."lifetime_deaths" IS NULL OR "campaign_ring_players"."lifetime_deaths" >= 0)

campaign_rings_finish_time_check.name: campaign_rings_finish_time_check
campaign_rings_finish_time_check.value: "campaign_rings"."finished_at" IS NULL OR ("campaign_rings"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_rings"."finished_at" >= "campaign_rings"."started_at")
